text.arabic_uthmani: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍۢ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ

words.gloss_range: resultative connector launching the command from the prior discourse
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) opens the ayah as a result of what came before, so the command to remind is not detached from the testimony in 52:28. The particle makes the first movement a warranted next step, and its prefixed surface compresses transition and command into one launch. The repeated connector pattern later in the ayah also gives the line a command-then-reason cadence.

topics.headline: resultative bridge from 52:28
topics.summary: The opening connector turns the imperative into a consequence of 52:28.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command grows out of the prior testimony in 52:28 rather than beginning as an isolated instruction.
topics.reason: The QAC particle note and clause boundary support a resultative link from the previous discourse into the imperative.

topics.headline: prefixed command launch
topics.summary: The attached particle makes the command begin through a visible hinge.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the transition before the action and sees it fused to the command surface.
topics.reason: The particle is a bound conjunction before the imperative, matching the CRITICAL claim that discourse linkage is part of the command surface.

topics.headline: twin connector cadence
topics.summary: The two connector openings form an audible command-reason pattern.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the ayah organize itself in two beats: command first, explanation second.
topics.reason: The bundle identifies a second connector at word 3, so the sound and structure of two connector openings are locally real.

words.gloss_range: Form II imperative, cause to remember or bring to mention; object is unstated here
words.root_gloss_range: broad field of remembering, mentioning, and visibility; local Form II selects causative reminding
words.prose: {{ar:ذَكِّرْ}} ({{tr:dhakkir}}) is a terse second-person imperative: the addressee is built into the verb before the later explicit pronoun appears. Its Form II shape makes the action causative, a calling of memory or mention outward, while the missing object keeps the act of reminding broader than one stated content. The command also stands against later accusations: the role is commissioned reminder, not autonomous hidden-knowledge performance, and 88:21 names the same reminder-role from the same root. Links with Lordship and grace make the reminder relational, grounded in the Lord named later rather than in the speaker alone.

topics.headline: imperative addressee and terse command
topics.summary: The verb carries command force and second-person reference in one compact form.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that direct address begins inside the verb itself, before the pronoun in the denial clause.
topics.reason: QAC marks a Form II second-person masculine singular imperative, and attachment evidence supplies the same singular discourse addressee.

topics.headline: open reminder object
topics.summary: The omitted object broadens the reminder instead of specifying content.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command foregrounds the act of reminding without narrowing it to one explicit object.
topics.reason: The verb instance marks a transitive imperative with no overt object, so preserving the compression is locally required.

topics.headline: Form II memory activation
topics.summary: The derived form pushes memory outward as an action performed on behalf of others.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is not private remembering but making remembrance happen for others; broader root visibility remains secondary.
topics.reason: The root family supports remembering and mentioning, while the local Form II imperative selects causative reminding; social visibility material is kept as a limited nuance.

topics.headline: mentionedness as background
topics.summary: The root family adds public mention to the memory command without changing its selected sense.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a public making-present nuance in the reminder, while unrelated gender associations do not control the local sense.
topics.reason: The local verb is a reminder command; wider mentionedness can color the public force, but the male branch is only historical background here.

topics.headline: prophetic reminder pattern
topics.summary: The command aligns with a broader reminder role pattern, including 88:21.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this imperative belongs to a recurring prophetic function, with 88:21 naming the reminder-role directly.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete recurrence and 88:21 as a same-root role formula, and no guardrail blocks the comparison.

topics.headline: reminding grounded in grace and Lordship
topics.summary: The command is locally connected to the grace and Lordship frame that follows.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reminder is tied to grace and Lordship in the same ayah, not framed as independent rhetoric.
topics.reason: The local sequence contains the command, the grace noun, and the Lord-title, matching the supplied co-occurrence claims.

topics.headline: scene shift into commission
topics.summary: The imperative marks the surah movement into direct commissioned address.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the rhetorical turn from prior testimony and divine goodness into a singular prophetic commission.
topics.reason: The first clause is imperative and follows the prior ayah boundary, so the boundary rows are coherent as discourse observations.

words.gloss_range: explanatory connector introducing the reason-clause after the command
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) at the second half does different work from the opener: it introduces the explanation for the command. The negated identity clause that follows is therefore the ground of the reminder, not a loose afterthought. Its attachment to the negator makes the turn from action to justification immediate, and the short-to-long sound reset marks the second beat.

topics.headline: explanatory ground for the command
topics.summary: The second connector turns the negated clause into the command’s reason.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial explains why the reminder can proceed.
topics.reason: QAC identifies this connector as explanatory or causal, and attachment evidence marks the following nominal clause as the explanation of the imperative.

topics.headline: explicit command-to-reason linkage
topics.summary: The particle links the completed command to its justification.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a tight command-reason pair rather than two adjacent statements.
topics.reason: The two-clause structure is explicit in attachment evidence, and the connector prevents loose juxtaposition.

topics.headline: fused second-beat cadence
topics.summary: The surface fusion and cadence make the second movement audible.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the second beat open quickly into the solemn negation.
topics.reason: The particle is prefixed to the negator and forms the surface opening of the reason clause.

words.gloss_range: Hijazi-style nominal negator governing the identity denial
words.prose: {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) starts the reason clause as an identity denial. Its scope runs across both rejected labels, and its cooperation with the later reinforcing predicate marker makes the denial stronger than a plain nominal sentence. The particle also keeps the classification issue direct and evaluative: the Prophet is not to be measured by those categories. A rare exclamatory possibility is only a grammatical pressure point; the standard local function remains negation.

topics.headline: one negation over two predicates
topics.summary: The negator governs the whole identity denial.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that both accusations fall under one identity-denial frame.
topics.reason: Attachment translation support marks negation scope over both coordinated predicates in the nominal clause.

topics.headline: intensified mā plus predicate bāʾ
topics.summary: The negator and later predicate marker cooperate to strengthen denial.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first denial is grammatically tightened by the later reinforcing predicate marker.
topics.reason: The later predicate is governed by a reinforcing bāʾ after the negator, matching the CRITICAL double-lock claim.

topics.headline: direct evaluative classification refusal
topics.summary: The denial is direct and category-focused.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the clause move immediately and directly from command into measured identity refusal.
topics.reason: The particle begins the explanatory nominal clause and QAC marks it as the operative negator.

topics.headline: rare parse pressure
topics.summary: Variant-like parse pressure is preserved as a limit, not allowed to overturn the local negation.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this surface is a grammatical pressure point, while local syntax keeps negation as the governing parse.
topics.reason: The supplied exclamatory possibility is not the local controlling parse because QAC and attachment evidence identify a negated nominal sentence.

words.gloss_range: explicit second-person singular pronoun anchoring the denied identity
words.prose: {{ar:أَنتَ}} ({{tr:anta}}) gives the addressee a visible place in the denial clause, even though the command has already encoded him. That shift from implicit subject to explicit pronoun changes the movement from doing the command to defending the person. Placed before the grace frame and the predicates, the pronoun becomes the hinge where divine support and human accusation meet. It also marks the boundary from prior reported testimony into present direct address.

topics.headline: explicit pronoun centers identity
topics.summary: The pronoun makes the denial personal and identity-focused.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the person addressed is visibly centered before any accusation is named.
topics.reason: The independent second-person pronoun is the subject of the negated nominal sentence, even though the addressee is already recoverable.

topics.headline: implicit command subject becomes explicit defense
topics.summary: The discourse moves from an implicit command subject to explicit identity defense.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from command execution to addressee-specific vindication.
topics.reason: The imperative has an implicit second-person subject, while the negated clause states the pronoun overtly.

topics.headline: pronoun between grace and accusation
topics.summary: The pronoun anchors the clause before grace and accusation are processed.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the Prophet’s person as the point where grace is applied before accusations are denied.
topics.reason: Local word order places the pronoun before the grace phrase and the denied predicates.

topics.headline: reported scene becomes direct address
topics.summary: The pronoun marks the new direct-address register.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary shift from prior communal testimony into direct singular address.
topics.reason: The cross-reference evidence identifies the same singular addressee across the imperative, pronoun, and suffix.

words.gloss_range: first bāʾ governing the grace phrase, with causal, accompanying, or oath-like force locally narrowed by syntax
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) first governs the grace phrase and places grace before either denied label arrives. Its force is narrowed locally to a semantic frame of cause, accompaniment, or solemn grounding; an oath-like reading can be noticed without displacing the clause syntax. Because the same particle shape appears again before the first predicate, this first use becomes the meaningful grace-frame while the later use supplies negation force. The repeated sound binds grace and accusation while their functions diverge.

topics.headline: grace as causal or accompanying frame
topics.summary: The first preposition frames the whole denial through grace.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices grace as the frame through which the denial is read before the accusations appear.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the grace noun between subject and predicate; its range includes cause, accompaniment, and oath, but local syntax keeps it tied to the grace phrase.

topics.headline: oath possibility kept secondary
topics.summary: The oath-like force intensifies the grace frame without replacing it.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that solemn oath coloring is possible, while the phrase still functions locally as the grace frame.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL row offers causal and oath readings; attachment evidence governs the noun as a prepositional complement, so the oath possibility is secondary.

topics.headline: bound preposition governs grace noun
topics.summary: The bound form makes the grace phrase a governed insertion.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that grace is grammatically governed and deliberately inserted before the predicate.
topics.reason: The preposition is bound to the grace noun and the attachment row places the phrase between subject and predicate.

topics.headline: two bāʾ sounds, two functions
topics.summary: The repeated preposition sound binds the clause while separating functions.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same small sound doing opposite jobs: grace-framing first, denial-reinforcing later.
topics.reason: The bundle aligns word 6 with the grace phrase and word 9 with the predicate reinforcement, supporting functional divergence.

words.gloss_range: specific grace or favor in construct with the following Lord-title
words.root_gloss_range: broad field of favor, ease, bliss, comfort, and material provision; local noun selects grace or favor
words.prose: {{ar:نِعْمَتِ}} ({{tr:niʿmati}}) is not a free-floating favor; as a construct it points to a specific grace completed by the Lord-title that follows. Because it sits between the pronoun and the first denied predicate, grace becomes the medium through which the identity denial is processed. The root field of ease, blessing, and bliss enriches the word, but the local noun remains grace or favor, not the broader material branches. The surah echo with 52:17 shifts bliss language into the present support of the messenger, while 52:28 supplication is reframed as present grace. That grace also stands opposite the later covered-mind accusation, and the phrase moves from a lighter grace noun into a heavier Lord-title.

topics.headline: specific Lord-sourced grace
topics.summary: The construct phrase makes the grace specific and relational.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grace is grammatically sourced in the following Lord-title, not left generic.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the noun as construct head with the Lord-title as its genitive dependent.

topics.headline: grace frames the whole denial
topics.summary: The inserted phrase makes grace the processing frame for the denial.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices grace before accusation, so the denial is embedded in divine support rather than bare rebuttal.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase occurs between subject and first predicate and functions as the clause-level circumstance or frame.

topics.headline: ease and bliss root coloring
topics.summary: The root field enriches grace without changing the local branch.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses grace as an enabling ease and support, while livestock and other material branches remain outside the local sense.
topics.reason: V4 shows multiple n-ʿ-m branches, but the local abstract construct noun selects grace or favor; ease and bliss can color the selected sense.

topics.headline: grace paired with Lordship and surah bliss
topics.summary: Grace is both locally possessed by the Lord and connected to the surah’s blessing thread.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a thread from 52:17 bliss and 52:28 supplication into present grace for the Prophet.
topics.reason: The local phrase joins grace with the Lord-title, and the CRITICAL rows provide concrete references to 52:17 and 52:28.

topics.headline: grace contrasted with covered-mind accusation
topics.summary: The grace field preconditions the later denial of harmful concealment.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices grace meeting the later concealment accusation as an opposite frame within the same ayah.
topics.reason: The same ayah contains the grace noun and the later passive label from the concealment field, so the contrast is locally grounded.

topics.headline: soft-to-heavy grace phrase cadence
topics.summary: Sound reinforces dependency within the grace phrase.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the grace phrase move from a lighter abstract noun into the heavier Lord-title.
topics.reason: The two-word construct phrase has the sound profile noted by the CRITICAL row and remains a minor phonetic payoff.

words.gloss_range: your Lord, a singular construct title with second-person suffix completing the grace phrase
words.root_gloss_range: broad Lordship field of owning, nurturing, sustaining, governing, and mastering; local form selects the personal divine Lord relation
words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbika}}) completes the grace phrase by making the source personal: it is the grace of your Lord. The suffix binds the same singular addressee into the Lord-title, so the defense is relational before it is polemical. The root’s nurture, ownership, and governance field makes Lordship continuous support, not just a title. It also carries the prior divine referent into direct address and joins a broader Surah 52 Lordship thread (52:7, 52:18, 52:37, 52:48). The doubled center gives the title audible weight at the source of grace.

topics.headline: personal suffix Lordship
topics.summary: The suffix makes Lordship personally addressed.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Lord relation is addressed personally to the same singular recipient of the command.
topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence ties the possessive suffix to the same singular addressee as the imperative and pronoun.

topics.headline: Lord-title completes grace construct
topics.summary: The construct endpoint makes the Lord the source and frame of grace.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that grace resolves in the Lord-title before the accusation appears.
topics.reason: The word is the genitive dependent completing the grace construct and stands immediately before the first denied predicate.

topics.headline: nurturing and governing root field
topics.summary: The root field gives the title sustaining content.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Lordship as sustaining care and authority, while unrelated lordship branches remain outside the local divine address.
topics.reason: The r-b-b field supports nurture, ownership, and governance; the local singular suffixed divine title narrows that field to the addressee’s Lord.

topics.headline: local Lordship thread and boundary carryover
topics.summary: The word carries continuity from prior divine reference into direct address.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the divine referent moving from prior supplication into a named personal Lord relation in this defense.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows identify local and wider Lordship recurrence, including Surah 52 references and the boundary from 52:28.

topics.headline: weighted Lord-title sound
topics.summary: Sound gives weight to the source of grace.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the Lord-title land as the heavy center of the grace phrase.
topics.reason: The doubled consonant in the local surface supports the minor sound observation.

words.gloss_range: reinforcing bāʾ attached to the first negated predicate
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) here is not another grace preposition; it attaches to the first denied predicate and strengthens the negation. After the inserted grace frame, this small particle resumes the identity frame and makes the accusation arrive already marked as rejected. Its echo with the earlier preposition creates balance, but the function has shifted from semantic framing to emphatic denial.

topics.headline: reinforced predicate negation
topics.summary: The second preposition strengthens the predicate denial.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first accusation is denied with grammatical emphasis, not merely named after a negator.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the first predicate under a reinforcing bāʾ after the nominal negator.

topics.headline: bound emphasis after grace insertion
topics.summary: The bound marker resumes and completes the first predicate frame.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the clause return from grace-frame to predicate denial through a bound marker.
topics.reason: The bāʾ is prefixed to the predicate noun and follows the intervening grace phrase.

topics.headline: same sound, changed function
topics.summary: The repeated sound links the two halves of the denial but not their grammar.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices internal sound balance while distinguishing grace-framing from negation-reinforcement.
topics.reason: The two bāʾ instances are locally aligned to different governed elements and functions.

words.gloss_range: indefinite active-participle role label: soothsayer or hidden-knowledge claimant, categorically denied here
words.root_gloss_range: root field includes soothsaying and broader institutional role labels; local denial selects the soothsayer or rival hidden-knowledge role
words.prose: {{ar:كَاهِنٍۢ}} ({{tr:kāhinin}}) is the first denied predicate and, as an indefinite role label under negation, it excludes category membership rather than one particular soothsayer. It arrives only after the grace frame has already been heard. Its active-participle shape names a practiced role, and the local sense is the rival hidden-knowledge channel that would misclassify reminder as divination. The rare distribution matters: 52:29 denies the messenger as this role, while 69:42 denies the recited speech as this kind of saying. Its sound and tanwīn also pair it with the final denied label while their meanings remain distinct.

topics.headline: first categorical denied predicate
topics.summary: The form denies membership in the soothsayer category.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first label is categorically excluded as an identity class.
topics.reason: The noun is an indefinite genitive predicate governed by the reinforcing bāʾ under the negated nominal frame.

topics.headline: rival hidden-knowledge role
topics.summary: The word names a rival epistemic role, narrowed locally to soothsaying.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial protects commissioned reminder from being recast as unauthorized hidden-knowledge performance; broader institutional cognate material stays secondary.
topics.reason: V4 supports the soothsayer or hidden-matters sense locally; cross-Semitic or broader institutional role background does not override that selected sense.

topics.headline: rare denial pattern with 69:42
topics.summary: The rare label is defined in denial, including the 69:42 parallel.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this rare root appears as a refused category, with 52:29 denying the person and 69:42 denying the speech.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide 69:42 as the concrete parallel and rarity claim, and contextual evidence marks the form as low occurrence and negated.

topics.headline: accusation delayed by grace frame
topics.summary: The accusation is structurally subordinated to the grace frame.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first accusation arrives only after grace has already framed the subject.
topics.reason: Local word order places the grace phrase between the subject pronoun and this predicate.

topics.headline: paired tanwīn and heavy sound
topics.summary: Sound binds the accusation pair without blending their senses.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first denied label pair with the final label while still keeping the meanings distinct.
topics.reason: The two predicate nouns share indefinite genitive cadence, and the local surface supports the noted sound texture.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle that carries the denial toward a second predicate
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) carries the clause from the first accusation to the second without restarting the subject and negator. With the following negator it functions as a nor construction, so coordination and renewed denial arrive together. The particle keeps the labels as two coordinated predicates rather than a single blended description, and its short beat resets the ear before the final noun.

topics.headline: coordinated predicate under one negation
topics.summary: The conjunction extends the identity denial without restarting the sentence.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second predicate remains inside the same denial frame.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the final predicate as conjoined with the first under the same negation.

topics.headline: wa with lā forms nor
topics.summary: The particle works as part of a compound nor marker.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the conjunction’s local value is completed by the following negator.
topics.reason: The surface sequence combines coordination with renewed negation before the final predicate.

topics.headline: coordination prevents predicate collapse
topics.summary: The conjunction links the labels while preserving their difference.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices two denied categories rather than one blended insult.
topics.reason: The final noun is coordinated with the first predicate, not appositional to it.

topics.headline: short reset before final noun
topics.summary: The small particle helps prepare the final denial rhythmically.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a brief reset before the longer closing accusation.
topics.reason: The short conjunction plus negator sequence precedes the final longer predicate.

words.gloss_range: renewed negator in the nor construction before the second predicate
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) renews negation inside the coordination, making the second accusation explicit rather than merely implied. It completes the nor construction: the labels are joined, but the second is separately refused. The long vowel also opens into the final long noun, giving the closing denial a drawn-out finish.

topics.headline: renewed negation for second predicate
topics.summary: The second negator keeps the denial from weakening after the first predicate.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second label is independently and audibly rejected.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the final predicate under the coordination and the negator as reinforcing the second complement.

topics.headline: layered mā to wa-lā architecture
topics.summary: The construction makes the rejection comprehensive.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the denial built in stages: initial negator, reinforced first predicate, then explicit second negator.
topics.reason: The local clause contains all elements named by the CRITICAL row: initial negation, first predicate reinforcement, and the nor coordination.

topics.headline: compound joins and separates
topics.summary: The compound marker performs linkage and renewed refusal together.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second predicate is both attached to the first and marked as a fresh denial.
topics.reason: The negator depends on the preceding conjunction and governs the following predicate.

topics.headline: long-vowel closing cadence
topics.summary: The sound gives the last denial a lengthened closure.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the negator open the final denial with length before the closing noun.
topics.reason: The local surface has the long-vowel negator immediately before the final predicate.

words.gloss_range: indefinite passive-participle label for one covered in mind or possessed, categorically denied here
words.root_gloss_range: broad concealment field including covering, hidden beings, gardens, shields, fetuses, and madness; local passive participle selects the denied covered-mind or possessed label
words.prose: {{ar:مَجْنُونٍ}} ({{tr:majnūnin}}) closes the ayah as the second denied predicate, still under the same identity-denial frame. Its indefinite form under the renewed negator excludes the whole category, not just one instance. The root image of covering and the passive-participle form make the accusation one of covered or externally affected intellect; broad concealment branches such as gardens and hidden beings inform the field but the local label remains the denied madness or possession charge. The word also joins a recurring prophetic accusation formula (15:6, 26:27, 37:36, 44:14, 68:2), while 52:17 turns the same root field toward gardens of reward, making this final use a rejected destructive counterpart. Its nasal texture lets the final accusation sound enclosed as it closes.

topics.headline: second categorical denied predicate
topics.summary: The final predicate categorically rejects the possessed or mad label.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word completes the identity denial as a second categorical refusal.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as the second coordinated predicate under the same negated nominal frame and explicit second negator.

topics.headline: paired form and final closure
topics.summary: The form pairs the predicates and the position gives the second one closure.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final word ringing as the closing denied label while formally paired with the first.
topics.reason: QAC marks the same genitive indefinite predicate form, and the word is the ayah-final term.

topics.headline: concealment and passive affectedness
topics.summary: The passive participle makes the denied label one of affected coveredness.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accusation pictures the mind as covered or acted upon, while broader concealment branches remain background.
topics.reason: V4 gives many concealment branches; the local passive participle and context select the denied covered-mind or possession label.

topics.headline: same-surah garden-to-accusation reversal
topics.summary: The surah echo turns beneficial concealment into a denied destructive label.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same concealment root field reversed from gardens of reward in 52:17 to a harmful accusation in 52:29.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give 52:17 as the concrete same-surah contrast; local sense remains the accusation, not garden imagery.

topics.headline: recurring prophetic accusation formula
topics.summary: The final label is a familiar polemical charge made local by the paired denial.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this denial participates in a repeated accusation pattern against prophets (15:6, 26:27, 37:36, 44:14, 68:2) while pairing it locally with the first denied role.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete formula references at 15:6, 26:27, 37:36, 44:14, and 68:2, and the local pair is syntactically coordinated.

topics.headline: nasal muffled sound texture
topics.summary: Sound texture reinforces the coveredness image without changing the sense.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final accusation as acoustically enclosed while paired with the earlier predicate.
topics.reason: The local surface supports the nasal and long-vowel sound observations as minor phonetic payoffs.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative rooted in ذ ك ر is followed by the coordinated denial of كاهن and مجنون.
baseline_models.mechanism: The command joins inward retrieval to outward mention. The two denials clear opposite corruptions of that speech: a hidden-report source and a mind whose access is veiled. The verse therefore identifies a lucid, speakable memory channel rather than merely rebutting insults.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something back to mind supplies the reminder's inward retrieval function.
Mention on the tongue carries retrieved content into open speech.
The hidden-report dealer supplies the first excluded account of the speech's source.
Madness as a veil over intellect supplies the second excluded account, this time of the speaker's cognitive condition.

changed_reading.before: A command to admonish followed by denial of two insults.
changed_reading.after: A mandate for open recollection whose source and cognitive condition are explicitly cleared of hidden brokerage and mental occlusion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causal or circumstantial phrase built from ن ع م and ر ب ب stands inside the denial, not outside it.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bestowed well-being and Lordly repair are not decorative reassurance; they form and sustain the capacity to remind. The non-dominant growth branch of the split ر ب ب mapping intensifies this as cultivated maturation. Lucidity is presented as an effect of care.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor and good condition supply the enabling condition named in the denial.
Repair, nurture, and completion make Lordship function as active formation of the reminder.
The split root's nourishment-and-growth image keeps a secondary formative reading live.
The veiled intellect is the disabling state that formative favor is said not to have produced.

changed_reading.before: The Lord's favor is a general reassurance that the accusation is false.
changed_reading.after: Lordly favor is the formative cause of stable, lucid reminder-speech and therefore the internal ground of the denial.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The command to continue ذ ك ر precedes two public identity labels.
baseline_models.mechanism: The reminder does more than transmit content: it keeps a truthful mention in circulation while hostile names try to settle the speaker's identity. Honorable mention and defamatory classification compete in the same social field, but the imperative prevents the labels from ending the speech.

activation_trace.role: Honorable mention and renown supply the public reputation that continued reminder can preserve.
Admonition gives the continued public act that resists identity capture.
The soothsayer label supplies one attempted social reclassification of the reminder.
The madness label supplies the second attempted reclassification and its claim of cognitive unfitness.

changed_reading.before: The verse clears the speaker's reputation before he continues preaching.
changed_reading.after: Continuing to remind is itself the counter-operation that keeps truthful mention alive while hostile labels attempt to fix identity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first response to the focus does not refute the reminder's content; it tries to let time terminate its bearer. Waiting, the unsettling turns of time, cutting off extension, and loss of sustaining force form an attrition strategy. The focus phrase about Lordly favor now carries durability: reminder continues inside a care that their waiting cannot manufacture or schedule.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed well-being supplies the sustaining gift opposed to anticipated attrition.
Staying, clinging, and lasting make Lordly relation function as endurance through hostile waiting.
Waiting and watching supply the accusers' temporal strategy against the speaker.
The repeated counter-wait prevents their timetable from remaining unilateral.
The troubling turns of time supply the medium through which they expect removal.
Cutting and diminishing until extension ceases supply the expected endpoint of their waiting.
Sustaining force and its disappearance preserve a coexisting reading in which they await depletion rather than only death.

structural_cues: 52:30 answers the focus by proposing to wait out the speaker, and 52:31 mirrors their waiting instead of conceding its timetable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies waiting, time's disturbing turns, cutting, and loss of sustaining force; I infer a strategy of attrition answered by grace-enabled duration. Alternatively, the phrase may refer simply to death, with no special contrast to the focus favor phrase.

changed_reading.before: Lordly favor secures the speaker's present lucidity against false labels.
changed_reading.after: Lordly favor also gives the reminder temporal staying power against opponents who expect the bearer, and therefore the speech, to wear out.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation questions expose a causal blank: were the accusers brought forth without any known thing, did they bring themselves forth, or did they originate the cosmos? The reminder restores the omitted relation to a Lord. This reverses the cognitive accusation without collapsing the two sides: the speaker is denied a veiled intellect, while the hearers display unstable certainty about their own source.

activation_trace.role: Bringing an absent matter back to mind supplies the repair of causal omission.
Lordship and ownership supply the source relation omitted by the self-origin alternatives.
A veiled intellect anchors the cognitive charge that the creation questions begin to reverse.
Bringing creation into existence supplies both sides of the impossible no-source or self-source alternatives.
A knowable thing that can be reported supplies the missing causal term under interrogation.
Measuring and apportioning expand the causal question from existence to ordered cosmic production.
Stable knowledge with doubt removed supplies the epistemic state the hearers have not reached.

structural_cues: 52:35-36 repeats creation across no-source, self-source, and cosmos-source questions before naming the lack of certainty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies impossible origin alternatives and failed certainty; I infer that the focus reminder restores the elided causal relation named by 'your Lord.' Alternatively, the questions may argue for creation without specifically redefining the function of reminder.

changed_reading.before: The verse clears the reminder's source and the speaker's cognition.
changed_reading.after: The reminder actively repairs causal amnesia: the supposedly mad speaker names a sustaining source while the accusers cannot stabilize an account of their own origin.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reminder comes by bestowed favor, then the context denies that its bearer asks a wage that would leave hearers under financial liability and weight. Grace therefore determines not only the message's source but its social economy: it is passed on without converting reception into debt.

activation_trace.role: Admonition supplies the communicative work whose price is questioned.
Bestowed benefaction supplies a gift economy upstream of the reminder.
Request and demand supply the transaction explicitly put in question.
Payment for labor supplies the fee the reminder's bearer does not exact.
Binding financial liability supplies the debt that a charged reminder would impose.
A burdensome load makes the social effect of debt materially felt.

structural_cues: 52:40 moves in one question from asking for payment to hearers being burdened by liability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies favor in the focus and a later denied chain of fee, liability, and burden; I infer that grace makes reminder nontransactional. Alternatively, the wage question may only establish sincerity without activating the semantics of favor.

changed_reading.before: The reminder is enabled by a gift from the Lord.
changed_reading.after: Because it comes through gift, the reminder is also transmitted as gift: it does not purchase authority by placing hearers in the speaker's debt.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus clears soothsaying and madness, the questions serially test more generators of the discourse: poetic production, allegedly commanding reason or dreams, fabricated attribution, and whether challengers can produce a comparable discourse. The two focus denials are therefore the first entries in an extended provenance test, not an isolated defense.

activation_trace.role: The hidden-report dealer supplies the first rejected production model.
The veiled intellect supplies the first rejected cognitive model.
Verse-composition and poet supply the next rival account of the discourse.
Forbearance and governed reason sharpen the irony that the accusers' own cognition may command excess.
The dream branch preserves a coexisting irony in which oneiric material, not disciplined reason, commands their claim.
Saying what was not and attributing it supplies the explicit fabrication hypothesis.
Freshly generated discourse turns the final challenge into a production test.

structural_cues: 52:30-34 repeatedly opens alternatives with questions, moves from labels to the accusers' cognition, and ends by demanding comparable discourse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a chain of rival labels and production claims; I infer that the chain audits causal provenance and reverses the cognitive charge toward the accusers. Alternatively, the questions may function as cumulative rebuke without forming a technical taxonomy.

changed_reading.before: The verse denies two false labels attached to the speaker.
changed_reading.after: The verse opens a serial elimination of rival source, cognition, and production models for the reminder, while the madness charge begins to recoil onto its makers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later questions distribute and then deny the powers bundled inside a soothsayer model: possessing guarded stores, controlling others, listening by an ascent, and writing the unseen. Clear proof is demanded instead. The focus speaker can therefore remind with authority while neither owning the source nor exercising sovereign control over hearers.

activation_trace.role: Hidden-report dealing anchors the access claim that the later questions dismantle.
Lordship, ownership, and authority reserve the ultimate source and control outside the reminder's human bearer.
Guarded storage supplies the image of exclusive possession of the Lord's reserves.
Overseeing control supplies the social power explicitly questioned alongside the treasuries.
Literal hearing supplies the claimed route of privileged reception.
Compelling proof supplies the public evidentiary burden imposed on the claimant to special hearing.
Manifest disclosure opposes the concealed access associated with soothsaying.
What is screened from sight supplies the inaccessible object the accusers are asked whether they possess.
Writing turns the alleged unseen access into a self-authorized record, reversing the soothsayer-like pretension onto the accusers.

structural_cues: 52:37-41 asks in sequence about the Lord's stores, control, elevated listening, proof, possession of the unseen, and writing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an access-and-control interrogation; I infer that it unpacks powers latent in the rejected soothsayer label and limits the reminder's office. Alternatively, these questions may target only the accusers' pretensions without defining the speaker's role.

changed_reading.before: The speaker is not a dealer in hidden reports.
changed_reading.after: The speaker bears an openly testable reminder without owning divine reserves, privately overhearing the unseen, or controlling the audience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The accusers can see a marked fragment of sky falling and still narrate it as accumulated cloud. Their speech does not merely fail to receive data; it covers and renames visible data. The focus charge of madness then reads as part of the same misnaming operation, projecting an interpretive veil onto the lucid reminder.

activation_trace.role: Covering and concealment anchor the interpretive veil activated by the later scene.
The accusation of a veiled intellect is the label that the later evidence-renaming pattern reverses.
Covering truth supplies the accusers' active interpretive operation.
Eye and insight supply the available perception that makes misclassification, rather than absence of data, decisive.
The split mapping's report-narration image keeps a second reading live: perception is immediately recoded as a story.
The non-dominant visible-mark image makes the falling object an identifying sign that speech overwrites.
A detached piece of body or sky supplies the concrete object seen.
Uttered naming supplies the act that converts perceived threat into a dismissive category.
Piling one thing over another supplies the substitute cloud-description laid over the seen fragment.

structural_cues: 52:44 places seeing and saying in one conditional sequence: perception is present, but the spoken category changes what the event is allowed to mean.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seeing, a marked falling fragment, and its renaming as piled cloud; I infer that the accusers perform the cognitive covering they project through the madness label. Alternatively, the scene may depict deliberate obstinacy rather than any reciprocal relation to the focus root.

changed_reading.before: The madness charge falsely describes the reminder's speaker.
changed_reading.after: The charge is one instance of a wider label-making practice that covers visible evidence and projects the resulting veil onto the speaker.

context_deltas.mechanism: The imperative sequence gives reminder a boundary and a sustaining environment. The speaker reminds, later leaves the resistant audience, then holds himself through the Lord's judgment under a guarding gaze and turns to praise. His task is persistent address without compulsory management; Lordly care bears the duration.

activation_trace.role: Admonition anchors the finite communicative task whose later boundary is supplied by context.
Leaving something supplies the explicit release of the resistant audience.
Holding the self from collapse supplies the reminder's required endurance.
Restraint and corrective return place outcome under the Lord's ordering rather than the reminder's control.
Repeated nurturing care carries both patient waiting and praise.
The eye of guarding care supplies the protective environment in which endurance occurs.
Exonerating praise redirects speech from endless argument toward the Lord once the audience is released.

structural_cues: The address moves from remind in 52:29 to leave them in 52:45 and then endure under watch and praise in 52:48.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of imperatives with different objects; I infer a bounded vocation in which address yields to release and patient worship. Alternatively, the commands may mark separate eschatological and devotional moments without defining the reminder's scope.

changed_reading.before: The imperative requires indefinite persistence despite false labels.
changed_reading.after: The imperative requires faithful address without coercive ownership of results; leaving, enduring, and praising are later phases of the same protected vocation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the male/female branch of ذ ك ر is not the ordinary sense of the focus imperative. It remains packet-anchored and is activated by the explicit daughter/son allocation in 52:39. Render it only as a buried gender-polarity echo that sharpens the allocation critique, never as an alternate translation of the command.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus reminder root carries a remote branch for male as opposed to female.

activation_trace.role: The male-against-female polarity supplies the dormant contrast activated by the later allocation question.
Sonship, daughterhood, and descent supply the kinship claim whose asymmetry is exposed.
Naming things as sons or daughters supplies the classificatory act that the question destabilizes.

changed_reading.before: The imperative asks the speaker to keep reminding despite personal labels.
changed_reading.after: At a contained root-echo level, the reminder also disturbs a gendered naming system that allocates daughters and sons asymmetrically.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the appointed-manager branch of ك ه ن is secondary to soothsaying. It remains anchored in the explicit negation and is activated by the later questions about treasuries, oversight, and proof. Render it as a limit on office and control, while retaining the primary hidden-report sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The negated كاهن has a branch for an appointed agent who manages another person's affairs.

activation_trace.role: An appointed affairs-manager supplies the unusual office explicitly denied to the reminder.
Lordship and ownership reserve sovereign management to the Lord named in the focus.
Guarding stores supplies the proprietary office the reminder does not possess.
Supervisory domination supplies the controlling role questioned in context.
Compelling proof replaces personal office as the legitimate basis for a claim.

changed_reading.before: The verse says the speaker is not a soothsayer.
changed_reading.after: The verse also limits the reminder's office: he does not privately administer divine stores or manage the audience as its controlling agent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links the night-cover branch of the focus root to the closing temporal imagery rather than to the ordinary sense of مجنون. It remains anchored in ج ن ن and in the explicit night, ending, and clearing branches. Render it as a poetic structural rhythm, not an alternate definition of madness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The negated ج ن ن form carries both mind-covering and night-covering branches.

activation_trace.role: Night covering supplies the focus root's temporal concealment image.
Mind covering remains the literal accusation from which the temporal analogy departs.
Night and its darkness make the covering phase explicit at the close.
The ending and passing of a thing supply transition out of the covered phase.
Cloud-clearing and cessation supply disclosure at the far end of the night sequence.

changed_reading.before: The focus simply denies that the speaker's intellect is covered.
changed_reading.after: The denial participates in a wider rhythm where truthful agency persists through covering until the scene turns toward ending and clearance.

strongest_changes: The waiting response after 52:29 recasts Lordly favor as durability against an attempted strategy of attrition.
The creation questions make reminder a repair of causal omission: the accusers cannot stabilize an account of their own source.
The denied wage, liability, and burden make grace the basis of a nontransactional reminder.
The post-focus questions turn the two denials into an extended audit of source, cognition, access, proof, and control.
The visible fragment renamed as cloud reverses the madness charge: interpretive covering belongs to the label-makers, not the reminder.
Reminder is bounded rather than managerial: later release, patience, care, and praise displace control of outcomes.
summary.what_was_special: The focus became a junction among several coexisting distinctions: remembrance versus attrition, Lordly source versus causal self-erasure, gift versus fee and debt, open proof versus hidden access, authorized speech versus ownership of hearers, and seeing versus renaming. Split and remote branches added live secondary readings without displacing the ordinary senses.
remaining_uncertainties: The attrition model depends on carrying the cutting and lost-force branches of م ن ن alongside the expected death sense.
The creation questions clearly expose failed certainty, but treating reminder as repair of causal memory remains a reader-supplied arrow.
The gendered allocation echo is branch-backed but too remote to bear lexical or interpretive weight without explicit qualification.
The night-to-clearing sequence may be poetic structure rather than deliberate root-level interplay.
The split-root narration and visible-mark activations in 52:44 sharpen misnaming but remain form-distant and should not bear the model alone.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Recall opposed to conjectural production.** `ذ ك ر` B003 is bringing to mind; `ك ه ن` B001 reports hidden matters by conjecture; `ج ن ن` B001 is concealment. I supply reminding -> re-presenting grounded truth, unlike hidden-source speculation. The speaker is an agent of recall under favor, not occult manufacture or covered reason.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 52:41's question about possession of the unseen completed the critique of the soothsayer label.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalın merkezini dişinin karşıtı olan erkek cinsiyet olarak kurar; çoğul adları ve erkek yavru doğurma anlatımları bu merkeze bağlı türetimlerdir. Ayrı sözlüksel birimlerde görülen anatomi ve erkeğe benzetme kullanımları çekirdek tanımı genişletmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım erkek cinsiyet çekirdeğini korur; doğurma, anatomi ve benzetme anlamları yalnız ilgili çekimli biçim ya da söz öbeğiyle sınırlandırılır.

concept_map.definition: Canlıların dişinin karşısında yer alan erkek cinsiyetinden olmasıdır. Bu çekirdeğe bağlı biçimler, erkek yavru dünyaya getirmeyi veya bunu alışkanlıkla yapmayı da anlatır.

facets.statement: İnsan ve hayvanlarda dişinin karşıtı olan erkek cinsiyet kategorisini belirtir.

Belirli çekimli biçimlerde bir dişinin erkek yavru doğurmasını veya çoğunlukla erkek yavru doğurmasını anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar erkek ile dişi arasındaki temel karşıtlıkta birleşir; ayrıca erkekler için kullanılan çoğul biçimleri ve erkek yavru doğurmaya ilişkin türetimleri aynı anlam alanına bağlar.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal unutulan bilginin yeniden zihinde hazır olması sonucunda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak zihinsel sonuç ve süreçtir; komşu bu sonucu meydana getiren neden veya hatırlatıcıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sunulan on dört adayın tümü değerlendirildi; bellek eksenini en iyi açıklayan beş ilişki seçildi, tanıma, düşünme, eski tanışıklık ve diğer kardeş dallar daha uzak veya yinelenen kaldı.
branches.branch_image_ar: استحضار الشيء بعد النسيان أو مع الحفظ
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الحفظ والاستحضار بالقلب والتذكر والاستذكار وما يكون خلاف النسيان.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مجرد جريان اللفظ على اللسان إذا لم يقصد حضور المعنى في النفس.
branches.source_phrase_ar: ذكرت الشيء خلاف نسيته (maqayis;sihah)؛ الذكر الحفظ للشيء وهو مني على ذكر (ayn;tahdhib)؛ ذكر بالقلب والتذكر طلب ما فات (ayn;tahdhib;mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin dilde söz olarak geçirilmesini merkeze alır ve kusur söyleyerek çekiştirmeyi bağlama bağlı bir alt kullanım olarak verir. Her sözün bu adla anılabileceği geniş açıklama, dalı bütün konuşma eylemleriyle özdeşleştirmeden yorumlanmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız sözle anma yapısı içinde geçerlidir; içten hatırlama, genel konuşma yetisi ve anılmanın doğurduğu ün ayrı dallardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım açıkça sözle anma yapısına bağlı tutulur; çekiştirme anlamı yalnız insanlardan kusurlarıyla söz etme bağlamında verilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi dil aracılığıyla söz konusu etmek, adını söylemek veya sözle görünür kılmaktır. İnsanların kusurlarını arkalarından söyleme, bu eylemin olumsuz bağlama bağlı bir türüdür.

facets.statement: Bir kişi, nesne veya konuyu dilde söz olarak geçirmek ve adını söylemektir.
Söz aracılığıyla bir şeyi bildirme veya görünür kılma yönünü taşır.
İnsanların kusurlarından arkalarında söz etme bağlamında çekiştirme anlamına gelir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir şeyin dilde söz olarak geçirilmesini ortak çekirdek sayar; insanları kusurlarıyla anmayı ise bağlama bağlı olumsuz bir kullanım olarak ekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişi, nesne veya konunun dilde adlandırılması ve söz konusu edilmesi gereken yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sözle adlandırma, görünür kılma ve bağlama bağlı olumsuz anma alanını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi ya da şeyin adı konuşma içinde geçirildiğinde doğal karşılık olarak kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyi söz içinde adlandırma ve söz konusu etme eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Her türlü söz sayılabilen geniş kaynak açıklamasını ve özel çekiştirme kullanımını belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir insanın eksik ve kusurlarından o yokken söz etme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İnsanları kusurlarıyla anma biçimindeki olumsuz özel kullanımı korur.
error_profile.loses: Tarafsız veya olumlu sözle anma çekirdeğini dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak belirli bir kişi, nesne veya konuyu söz içinde anmayı gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, belirli bir içeriği anma koşulu olmadan konuşma seslerini dışa vurmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal düşüncenin dil ve ses aracılığıyla dışarı çıkarılmasını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Dile getirme genel bir konuşma eylemidir; sözle anma ise belirli bir içeriği adlandırıp konu etmeye bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak olumlu, tarafsız veya olumsuz olabilen genel sözle anmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu bir kişiyi en iyi nitelikleriyle överek yüceltme eylemidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Övme sırasında kişi olumlu özellikleriyle söz içinde anılır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Övme zorunlu olarak olumlu değer yükler; odak dalı ise değer yönü taşımadan yalnız söz konusu etmeyi de kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak tarafsız ve olumlu sözle anmayı da kapsayan daha geniş bir eylemdir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kusur arama, küçümseme ve gizli ya da açık saldırı yollarını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal bir kişiyi kusurları üzerinden söz konusu etme bağlamında örtüşebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odaktaki olumsuz kullanım arkadan kusur söylemeyle sınırlıdır; komşu daha geniş yerme ve saldırı davranışlarını içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak içeriğin dil aracılığıyla dışa vurulmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu içerik söylenmese bile onun zihinde korunması veya geri çağrılmasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir şeyi hatırlamak, onun daha sonra sözle anılmasına eşlik edebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Hatırlama zihinsel bir durum veya süreçtir; sözle anma ise dışa vurulan dilsel eylemdir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak bir kişi veya şeyden söz etme eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu sürekli ve olumlu anılmanın doğurduğu iyi ün, onur ve saygınlığı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişinin toplum içinde anılması onun ününün oluşmasına katkı sağlayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak tekil dilsel eylemdir; komşu bu tür anmaların toplumsal sonucu olan kalıcı itibardır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sunulan on dört adayın tümü değerlendirildi; konuşma, övgü, yerme, hatırlama ve ünle en yararlı beş sınır seçildi, diğerleri özel konuşma türleri veya uzak kardeş anlamlardı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ذكر الشيء باللسان والقول والإظهار والتسمية، ومنه ذكر الناس بخير أو بسوء إذا دل السياق.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الحفظ القلبي وحده ولا الشرف والصيت الناتج عن الذكر.
branches.source_phrase_ar: ثم حمل عليه الذكر باللسان (maqayis)؛ الذكر جري الشيء على لسانك (ayn;tahdhib)؛ ذكرته بلساني وبقلبي (sihah)؛ كل قول يقال له ذكر وذكر باللسان (mufradat)؛ يذكر الناس أي يغتابهم ويذكر عيوبهم (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Tanrı'yı anmaya yönelen kulluk eylemlerini; yakarış, övgü, yüceltme, şükretme, buyruklara uyma ve dinî metin okuma örnekleriyle açıklar. Geçici çerçeve bu ibadet odaklı kapsamı doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Her sözlü anma bu dala girmez; eylemin Tanrı'ya yönelmiş bir kulluk, övgü, yakarış veya itaat niteliği taşıması gerekir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel kulluk anlamı ile Tanrı'yı anma söz öbeği ayrılır; dinî metin okuma ancak bu kulluk yönelimi içinde değerlendirilir.

concept_map.definition: Tanrı'yı kulluk amacıyla anmak; ona yönelen yakarış, övgü, yüceltme, şükretme, buyruklara uyma ve dinî metin okuma eylemlerini yerine getirmektir.

facets.statement: Tanrı'ya yönelmiş bir kulluk ve bilinçli anma eylemidir.
Yakarış, övgü, yüceltme ve şükretme bu kulluk yöneliminin sözlü veya içsel biçimleridir.
Buyruklara uyma ve dinî metni bu amaçla okuma da aynı kulluk alanında değerlendirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar Tanrı'yı anmayı ibadet, yakarış ve övgü ekseninde birleştirir; yüceltme, şükretme, itaat ve dinî metin okumayı bu yönelimin farklı gerçekleşmeleri sayar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Tanrı'ya yönelen yakarış, övgü, şükür, itaat ve dinî okuma eylemlerini ortak bir kulluk kavramında toplar.

error_profile.preserves: Tanrı'ya yönelme koşulunu ve kulluğun sözlü, içsel ve davranışsal biçimlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tanrı'ya bilinçli biçimde yönelen övgü, yakarış veya kulluk eylemi genel olarak belirtilirken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tanrı'ya yönelen bilinçli anma ve kulluk çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Buyruklara uyma ve dinî metin okuma gibi davranışsal gerçekleşmeleri açıkça belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kulluğun sözlü yakarış, övgü ve yüceltme yönü bağlamda baskın olduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yakarış, övgü ve yüceltme biçimindeki kulluk eylemlerini korur.
error_profile.loses: Şükretme, itaat ve dinî okuma gibi öteki gerçekleşmeleri kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kulluk amacıyla anma, yakarış, övgü, şükretme ve itaat

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak Tanrı'ya yönelmiş kulluk, yakarış, övgü ve itaat koşulunu taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu herhangi bir kişi, nesne veya konuyu söz içinde anmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kulluk amacıyla anma ile sözle anma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Tanrı'yı sözle anma, her iki dalın kesişebildiği bir gerçekleşmedir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Genel sözle anma yalnız dilsel eylemdir; odak dalı ise belirli bir yöneliş ve kulluk amacı gerektirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak çok sayıda sözlü ve davranışsal kulluk biçimini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu yakarışın kabulü için söylenen belirli bir karşılıkla sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal yakarış ve dinsel söz eylemi bağlamında aynı sahnede yer alabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Belirli kabul dileği kendi kalıplaşmış işlevine sahiptir; odak ise tek bir söz kalıbına bağlı olmayan geniş kulluk alanıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak övgü, şükür, itaat ve farklı yakarış türlerini birlikte kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu özellikle su ve yağmur istemeye yönelik yakarıştır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yağmur isteme eylemi Tanrı'ya yönelen bir yakarış olarak odak alanında gerçekleşebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu isteğin konusunu su ve yağmurla sınırlar; odak ise konu sınırlaması olmayan kulluk yönelimidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak anma, yakarış, övgü, okuma ve itaat gibi etkin kulluk biçimleridir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu ibadet sırasında sıradan konuşmayı bırakıp susma davranışıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı ibadet ortamında birlikte bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Sessizlik ibadetin düzenleyici bir koşuludur; odak ise Tanrı'ya yönelen anma ve kulluk eyleminin kendisidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sunulan on beş adayın tümü değerlendirildi; genel anma, belirli yakarışlar ve ibadet sessizliğiyle ilgili dört ilişki seçildi, kalan adaylar aynı sahnenin daha uzak parçalarıydı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الصلاة والدعاء والثناء والتسبيح والشكر والطاعة وقراءة القرآن من حيث هي ذكر لله.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه كل ذكر لساني عام ولا الكتاب المسمى ذكرا إلا من جهة القراءة والعبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الذكر الصلاة والدعاء والثناء (ayn;tahdhib)؛ الذكر قراءة القرآن والتسبيح والدعاء والشكر والطاعة (tahdhib)؛ ولذكر الله أكبر واذكروا الله (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dini açıklayan kitabı, peygamberlere indirildiğine inanılan kitapları, Kur'an'ı ve önceki kutsal kitapları aynı dalda toplar. Geçici çerçeve metinsel nesneyi doğru biçimde ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kutsal veya vahyedilmiş sayılan kitabın kendisidir; okuma, çalışma, ibadet ya da zihinsel hatırlama eylemi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın kutsal kitap anlamını verir; okuma veya ibadetle ilgili söz öbeklerinden yeni bir genel anlam aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Dinin hükümlerini ve açıklamalarını içeren, bir peygambere indirildiğine inanılan kutsal kitaptır. Kapsam hem Kur'an'ı hem de daha önceki kutsal kitapları içine alabilir.

facets.statement: Dinin ayrıntılarını bildiren ve ilahi kaynaklı kabul edilen kitaptır.
Kur'an ile ondan önceki peygamberlere bağlanan kutsal kitapları kapsayan bir üst ad olabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dini açıklayan peygamber kitaplarını ortak çekirdek olarak verir ve kapsamı Kur'an ile önceki kutsal kitaplara kadar genişletir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dinin hükümlerini içeren peygamber kitabı genel bir tür olarak anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dini açıklama, kutsal kabul edilme ve peygambere indirilme bileşenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlam kitabın dini ve vahyedilmiş niteliğini zaten açıkça gösterdiğinde doğal kısa karşılık olarak kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dini içerikli ve kutsal kabul edilen kitap olma çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Peygambere indirilme ve önceki kitapları kapsayan üst ad olma ayrıntısını açıkça belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak kutsal kitabın bütünü veya kutsal kitap türüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kutsal metnin sınırları belirlenmiş bir bölümü ve ayrıca yüksek konum anlamıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kutsal kitabın belirli bölümleri, bütün metnin yapısal parçalarıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak bütün kitap veya kitap türünü, komşu ise onun çevrelenmiş bölümünü adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak okunan kutsal metinsel nesnenin kendisidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu metni sesli veya sessiz okuma, başkasına okutma ve birlikte çalışma eylemleridir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kutsal kitap, okuma eyleminin önemli bir nesnesi olabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kitap bir nesnedir; okuma ise yalnız kutsal kitaplarla sınırlı olmayan bir eylemdir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dini içeriği taşıyan kitabın kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu bir kitabı okuyup yineleyerek öğrenme ve belleğe yerleştirme sürecidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kutsal kitap üzerinde okuma ve öğrenme çalışması yapılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak metinsel nesnedir; komşu farklı kitaplara da uygulanabilen öğrenme etkinliğidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sunulan on beş adayın tümü değerlendirildi; kitap bölümü, okuma ve çalışmayla ilgili üç sınır seçildi, öteki adaylar ad, görünme, kulluk veya gizli haber alanlarında uzak kaldı.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكتاب الذي فيه تفصيل الدين وكل كتاب للأنبياء والقرآن والكتب المتقدمة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه فعل التذكر ولا مطلق الصلاة والدعاء إلا إذا كان اللفظ يدل على الكتاب أو القرآن.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الذكر الكتاب الذي فيه تفصيل الدين وكل كتاب من كتب الأنبياء ذكر (ayn;tahdhib)؛ القرآن والكتب المتقدمة والزبور من بعد الذكر (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kişinin toplum içindeki yüksek konumunu, iyi ününü, övgüyle anılmasını ve saygınlığını ortak bir sonuç alanında toplar. Geçici çerçeve bu toplumsal değer ve yayılmış tanınma bileşimini doğru verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal anma eyleminin kendisi değil, kişinin olumlu biçimde anılmasıyla bağlantılı onur, iyi ün ve saygınlıktır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın iyi ün ve onur anlamı korunur; kişi niteleyen söz öbeği bellek gücü ile iyi anılmayı kendi bağlamında birleştirir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin insanlar arasında olumlu biçimde tanınmasından doğan iyi ün, onur, övgü ve yüksek saygınlıktır.

facets.statement: Kişinin toplum içinde taşıdığı onur ve yüksek saygınlıktır.
Kişinin olumlu biçimde anılmasıyla yayılan iyi ün ve övgüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar onur ve yüksek konumu, insanlar arasında yayılan iyi ün ve övgüyle birlikte tek bir olumlu toplumsal itibar alanında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin olumlu tanınması ile toplumsal yüksekliğini birlikte anlatmak gereken bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Onur, yayılan iyi ün, övgü ve toplumsal saygınlık bileşenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin insanlar arasında olumlu biçimde tanınıp anılması bağlamda öne çıktığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Olumlu tanınma ve insanlar arasında yayılan övgü yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Yüksek konum ve onur bileşenini tek başına açıkça belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Toplumdaki yüksek değer ve itibar, yaygın tanınmadan daha önemli olduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin yüksek toplumsal değeri ve saygınlığı anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Adının yayılması ve övgüyle anılması yönünü açıkça kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: belleği güçlü, yiğit veya iyi anılan adam

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak iyi üne ek olarak onur ve yüksek toplumsal konumu da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu özellikle insanlar arasında yayılmış güzel ve olumlu ünle sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kişinin insanlar arasında olumlu biçimde tanınıp anılmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu yayılan iyi üne daha dardır; odak bu üne onur ve toplumsal yükseklik bileşenini de ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak kişinin yüksek konumunu ve saygınlığını da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kişinin insanlar arasında güzel sözle anılması ve övülmesine odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal olumlu anılma ve iyi ün alanında büyük ölçüde örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu güzel söz ve övgü sonucuna daha yakındır; odak bunun yanında onur ve yüksek konumu da kurucu sayar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak yaygın olumlu anılma ve iyi ün bileşenini taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kutsallık, büyüklük, önderlik ve görüş üstünlüğü gibi ek toplumsal boyutlar içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kişinin toplumdaki onur ve yüksek değerini anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak iyi anılma ve ünle bağlantılıdır; komşu ün bulunmasa da büyüklük ve otoriteyi ifade edebilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak ünün olumlu, övgüye değer ve onurlu olmasını gerektirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız belirli hak söz öbeğinde bir hakkı kayda geçiren yazılı belgeyi ve bu belgelerin çoğulunu verir. Geçici çerçeve yapıya bağlı belge anlamını eksiksiz yansıtır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız hatırlatan bir nesneyi değil, başkasında hatırlamayı meydana getirme eylemini, hatırlamaya yarayan aracı ve bazı biçimlerde sık anmayı birlikte verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak geçici nesne merkezli çerçeve bu süreç ve yoğunluk yüzlerini açıkça kapsayacak biçimde genişletilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hatırlamanın kendisi değil, onu doğuran eylem veya araçtır; sık anma anlamı da yalnız kaynakta belirtilen biçime bağlı bir yoğunluk yüzüdür.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hatırlatma eylemi, hatırlatıcı araç ve sık anma ayrı yüzler olarak tutulur; bu yapıların hiçbiri yalın zihinsel hatırlamayla özdeşleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir bilginin yeniden zihinde belirmesini sağlamak veya buna yarayan bir işaret ya da araç sunmaktır. Belirli bir biçim ayrıca bir şeyi sıkça anmayı anlatabilir.

facets.statement: Bir başkasında veya kişinin kendisinde unutulmuş bilginin yeniden hatırlanmasını sağlar.
Bir ihtiyacı veya bilgiyi hatırlamaya yarayan işaret, not ya da araç olarak gerçekleşir.
Belirli bir ad biçiminde bir şeyi sık ve yoğun biçimde anma anlamı taşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar hatırlatmayı başkasında hatırlama meydana getiren geçişli eylem ve hatırlamaya yarayan araç olarak verir; ayrıca belirli biçimde sık anma yoğunluğunu kaydeder.

error_profile.preserves: Kuşun tür kimliğini açık ve doğal biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Bazı kullanımlardaki özel erkek veya dişi birey ayrımını belirtmez.
